decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial line builds directly on the firm's in-house natural skincare formulation know-how and is still featured on its own page, so management can interpret results and refine it rather than drop it.

The hyaluronic serum fits the firm's established facial care competence and has remained on the website for two years, though its low prominence and active-ingredient focus make it somewhat more exposed than the core line.

The cleansing oil is close to the firm's existing knowledge and was launched only recently, but the earlier removal of the cleansing milk shows the cleansing segment is being reshaped, so there is moderate risk.
